items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Evidence: Woot documentation proves API access mechanics only; current public terms do not establish commercial/public rights to collect, store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize the data. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, privacy, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization.

Fleet disposition: ordinary reversible growth is conditional where it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked where required evidence is missing.

Compliance evidence is incomplete: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown; open finding categories include banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms. No failures may be treated as resolved without site-specific dated evidence. Next evidence action: enumerate the authoritative failing and unknown checks and attach a dated remediation result or explicit blocker for each.

Data-quality and revenue evidence remain bounded. Analytics is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain; repair the listed sources without treating unavailable data as zero. Amazon evidence for 2026-09-21 is 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission under tracking ID other; it is not site-attributable. Preserve margin, ROI, forecasts, payback, and causal lift as unknown and authorize no spend or monetization expansion.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics or affiliate configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Continue only the existing readiness packets. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence by 2026-09-30T17:00Z; escalate incomplete packets to CTO.
